body:
This the day afterwards, so my typing might be a bit iffy.
It was a fairly boring night, as the power was out, I decided to take a lunesta to sleep. They work quite well for me. Anyway, a few minutes after I take it, the power goes back on. That meant no really point in me sleeping because I would then have 2 more hours to kill.
At some point, later in the night, I decided to take another pill every so often. By 10pm, I had take at least 21mg of Lunesta. It had this very mellow feeling to it.
To elaborate more on the feelings, it felt like I loved the whole world. Nothing mattered at that moment, and it was a great feeling. Unlike any other pills I had used for sure. Everything had this pulsating and vibrating to it, and I could help but stare at them on hours at it. To wrap this up, I think I went to be around one, as I was very tired and had school the next day.
When I wake up, none of my brain was functioning correctly.
When I wake up, none of my brain was functioning correctly.
I'd go to send a text, and all that came out was 'wwmafojdfurjgp' or some crazy shit like that. Skipped school needlessly to say. Later, my mother asked why I had taken all of the pills I had for two medications. This freaked me out, because I knew I had only taken a few. Turns out in some sort of blackout sleep walking state, I had taken the rest of the Lunesta. I looked back and it also turns out I had messaged some friends about really stupid shit around 2 in the morning. This still freaks me out.
In conclusion, be very careful when taking any type of hypnotics, because this experience is awful. I can't concentrate on a thing, so I can barely write this up. Hypnotics are much more dangerous than I could have guessed.
